topic: TencentCloud AgentObs SDK for DeepSeek Harness

key_points: Official Tencent CLS doc: plug tencentcloud-agentobs-sdk-dsh into DSH, converts native lifecycle into Agent Trace data shipped to CLS
Two onboarding paths: Skill-based quick setup (auto create/reuse log topic, auto-install) vs manual step-by-step config
After onboarding you can view full call chain + parent/child relations among Agent, reasoning steps, model calls, tool calls
Per-step metrics: execution time, model time-to-first-token (TTFT), input/output/cached tokens
Success/failure status, failure reasons, retry process, and multi-turn session correlation
Prereqs: DSH >=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0, Node.js >=18, CLS enabled, CAM-role/child-account/secret creds
Troubleshooting FAQ covers no-trace, missing prompt/response/tool params, duplicate traces, missing internal model calls
DSH observability plugin reporting GenAI trace data directly to Tencent Cloud Log Service (CLS)
Maps DSH native session, agent loop, LLM stream, tool lifecycle into a 5-layer span hierarchy: entry -> agent -> step -> chat -> tool
No extra OTLP collector or sidecar needed — uses tencentcloud-cls-sdk-js Protobuf upload directly
Install via dsh plugin per profile (web/headless/harness); restart DSH after install/update
pnpm v9+ blocks protobufjs build scripts -> run pnpm approve-builds / enable-scripts in profile dir
Config via env vars (CLS_ENDPOINT, CLS_TOPIC_ID, CLS_SECRET_ID/KEY, CLS_SERVICE_NAME) or cordis.patch.yml; file config takes precedence
Content capture on by default; disable with captureContent:false or OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=false
Config table: batchMaxSize 32, flushIntervalMs 5000, retryTimes 3, maxQueueSize 2048, contentMaxChars 128000, debug off
License Apache-2.0, TypeScript
Positions runtime observability as the most-overlooked aspect after AI agent deployment
When agent count grows from 1 to 50, token consumption, concurrency bottlenecks, KB capacity, plugin call volume can spiral
Tencent Cloud ADP Resource Dashboard: two-tier (Enterprise View + Space View) monitoring
Covers 7 dimensions: model usage, model concurrency, KB capacity, plugin usage, platform usage, usage summary, resource consumption
DeepSeek Harness (DSH): Everything is a Plugin (~169K stars at research time)
Plugin ecosystem is the core extensibility mechanism DSH uses; observability is one such plugin type
DSH generates session, reasoning-step, model-call and tool-call runtime data during coding tasks
agentobs (PyPI) is a reference implementation of RFC-0001 AGENTOBS, the Observability Schema Standard for Agentic AI Systems
Shows the broader push toward standardized agent-observability schema (parallel to Tencent's 5-layer span model)
Context that Tencent's AgentObs naming aligns with a growing industry-standard observability schema for agentic AI

stats.fact: DeepSeek Harness (deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) had ~169,835 GitHub stars at research time (2026-08-20), reflecting massive adoption of the 'everything is a plugin' agent harness.
The tencentcloud-agentobs-sdk-dsh repo was created 2026-08-18 (two days before this research) with ~5 stars / 3 forks, indicating a very new, rapidly-shipped integration.
Official Tencent CLS doc for DeepSeek Harness onboarding was last updated 2026-08-18.
The SDK requires DeepSeek Harness >=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0 and Node.js >=18.0.0.
Plugin reports traces directly to CLS via Protobuf through tencentcloud-cls-sdk-js — no OTLP collector or sidecar deployment required.

angles: Zero-extra-infra: direct-to-CLS Protobuf shipping vs typical OTLP-collector/sidecar agent-observability setups
The 5-layer span hierarchy (entry/agent/step/chat/tool) as a clean mapping of DSH's native session/agent-loop/LLM-stream/tool lifecycle
Cost & privacy tension: content capture (prompts/responses/tool args) is ON by default — sensitive code/creds can go to CLS; how to disable safely
Two onboarding paths (Skill auto-setup vs manual) lowering the barrier for AI-first teams
Per-run granularity: TTFT, in/out/cached tokens, success/failure/retry — concrete observability value beyond basic logging
The AgentObs name ties into the emerging RFC-0001 AGENTOBS schema standard for agentic AI observability
